question.text: STT on SALE OF FUTURES in securities (levied on the seller) is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 9.3.3, STT on sale of futures in securities = 0.02%, levied on the seller. The Trap: Other rates apply to different STT categories. Cross-Exam Context: F&O-heavy Cat III AIFs incur material STT. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Track F&O STT quarterly for cost-of-business assessments.
